services.name: School PE clinic

services_shape: class: seats in a scheduled class with a set number of places by level and age; a party books the gym or the customer's home for one group; at a school or a home (flow B) a coach goes to the customer
questions_before_times: which class or party, and the date
the child's age, to pick the level (ages 2 to 4 with a parent on the mat)
how many children, for a party or a school or home class
new to gymnastics, or been before
safety_stop: a child not breathing, unresponsive, or with a hard fall on the head right now
first_steps: Health questions on the secure page
license: none from the state for gymnastics or cheer coaching in most places; coaches hold a current coaching or first-aid certificate the business says is current; where the state licenses a gym or a child-care program, the business's own registration or license is shown only once it is on file
staff_skills: tumbling, beam, cheer, tumble for toddlers, adult classes; the levels each coach may teach
messages_never: health notes, injuries, a child's name and age in texts to anyone but the parent: only on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
